name: UI Computed Display
description: Computed frontend display changes for article word count, reading time, mock read counts, Popular Tags top-five labels, and existing-field timestamps.

verificationSteps: Confirm the requested display can be computed from existing frontend data.
Confirm no backend model, database, or API contract change is required.
Verify affected route and component paths before patching.

blockingQuestions: Ask if the display requires data that is not already available in frontend state or API responses.
safeDefaults: Use 500 Chinese characters per minute for reading time when language or rate is unspecified.
Display minimum reading time as 1 minute.
For Popular Tags top-five labels, label only the first five items in the existing tag order.
confirmationDefaults: Treat the change as frontend-only unless requested data is absent.

allowedChanges: Verified frontend source files under TARGET_REPO_PATH
Small frontend helper functions for pure display calculations
successCriteria: The display is computed from existing frontend data.
No backend, database, or API contract file is modified.
Reading time uses 500 Chinese characters per minute and minimum 1 minute unless overridden.
Frontend validation plan is produced from discovered scripts.
